batch_name: corrected equal-information LightGBM packet (matched exposure + persisted eval history + full persistence)
config_hash_definition: sha256 over json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8') of the 'config' object in this file

config.text_source_identity_convention: TEXT-SOURCE IDENTITY CONVENTION (amendment-2, 2026-10-15): declared text-source files (extensions .json, .md, .py) are identified by sha256 over their LF-NORMALIZED content (every CRLF and lone CR is normalized to LF before hashing), so a registered text identity is reproducible across git EOL materializations (core.autocrlf / eol attributes). Declared binary files (extensions .joblib, .npy, .parquet, .pkl) and any other extension are identified BYTE-EXACT (sha256 over the raw file bytes). Byte-exact values registered under the prior amendment-1 convention are preserved as historical records and are not re-verified against disk; verification uses the normalized value for text-source files and the byte-exact value for binary files.
config.eol_and_identity_note: IDENTITY/EOL CONVENTION for this batch: declared text-source files (.py/.json/.md) are hashed LF-NORMALIZED (every CRLF and lone CR normalized to LF before sha256) so registered text identities are reproducible across git EOL materializations; declared binary files (.parquet/.pkl/.joblib/.npy) and all registered inputs are BYTE-EXACT; the execution record (run_manifest.json) states this convention on every run

adapter.note: the v2 runner IS the corrected comparison implementation (single owner: iteration selection -> fresh refit -> reference on the same rows -> persistence); it exposes config_sha256() and LGBM_EQUAL_INFO_CONFIG for the shared identity verifier

iteration_selection_procedure.selection_data: training-only inner carve-out of base_train (last 20% of distinct base_train slate dates); the calibration sub-block and the assessment frames are NEVER visible to selection
iteration_selection_procedure.history: per-round evaluation history on the inner block persisted via lgb.record_evaluation (both registered metrics, binary_logloss + binary_error) to inner_eval_history_<fold>.json
iteration_selection_procedure.selected_iteration: booster.best_iteration under first_metric_only=True (fallback num_boost_round), persisted per fold
iteration_selection_procedure.refit: FRESH LightGBM refit on the FULL base_train at the chosen fixed iteration; NO early stopping, no valid sets, no callbacks in the refit; scoring uses ONLY this refit booster (asserted num_trees == chosen iteration)
iteration_selection_procedure.first_metric_only_diagnostic: PREDECLARED DIAGNOSTIC: early stopping tracks the FIRST registered metric (binary_logloss) only (lgb.early_stopping(first_metric_only=True)); binary_error stays registered and is recorded in the persisted eval history as a descriptive diagnostic. Declared BEFORE execution; addresses the v1 RUN_ASSESSMENT mechanism-2 confound (coarse binary_error trigger). A diagnostic declaration, not a hyperparameter change

matched_exposure_contract.contract: BOTH arms consume the SAME fit rows per fold: the LightGBM scoring model is a FRESH refit on the FULL base_train and the both-EW logistic reference is fit on the SAME full base_train (closes the v1 fit-row asymmetry 98,466/176,080/245,633 vs 123,081/219,078/306,791)
matched_exposure_contract.assertion: per-fold assertion n_fit_rows(LightGBM refit) == n_fit_rows(logistic) == n(base_train); training-row IDs persisted per arm per fold (fit_rows_<fold>__<candidate>.parquet) and hash-compared
matched_exposure_contract.calibration_rows: calibration sub-block rows equal for both arms (unchanged from v1); eval rows equal (unchanged from v1)

config.no_search: no hyperparameter/feature/window/calibration search anywhere in this batch: hyperparameters are the recorded v1 frozen values, the feature set is the registered 8 both-EW columns, the folds are the existing chronological dev folds, calibration is the same sigmoid definition - all recorded, none searched

equal_information_contract.features_binding: identical to the both-EW logistic reference P1_H3_incumbent_refit (6 frozen B features + ew_pitcher + ew_batter; comparison.py FEAT_H3)
equal_information_contract.rows: identical rows for both candidates per fold at EVERY stage: same full base_train for the LightGBM refit and the logistic fit (matched exposure), same calibration sub-block, same eval frame; per-fold eval identity hash (sorted (game_pk, at_bat_number, batter)) persisted and identical across candidates
equal_information_contract.folds_binding: same registered dev folds as the both-EW logistic reference (block_2024H1 / block_2024H2 / block_2025H1), same fold_calibration_rule (60 PA-bearing-day sigmoid sub-block), same metric definitions

training_only_tuning.early_stopping: permitted on ONE inner block carved out of base_train ONLY (last 20% of distinct base_train slate dates), for ITERATION SELECTION only; the selected iteration is then re-used in a fresh full-base_train refit
training_only_tuning.prohibited_sources: no early stopping on the calibration sub-block, no early stopping on or any label use from the dev-assessment frames; the eval frame is never visible to fitting
training_only_tuning.no_search: no hyperparameter search outside the inner-carve-out iteration selection; the frozen config is recorded, not searched
training_only_tuning.dev_assessment_labels: dev-assessment labels are NEVER used for training, stopping, scaling, or calibration

evaluation.bootstrap: paired slate-date bootstrap, block-stratified, shared draw stream; 1-D replicate shape assertions before elementwise subtraction; the replicate draws are persisted (bootstrap/contrast_draws__<contrast>.parquet)
evaluation.p_values: null-centered approximate bootstrap p-values + Holm step-down across the registered contrast family per the registered C3.8 method (comparison.py null_centered_contrast_test / holm_adjust)
evaluation.calibration_lane: CAL SEPARATE: sigmoid calibration on the calibration sub-block ONLY, same definition as the executed logistic adapters; reported separately, never merged with RAW; no CAL contrast claims

baseline_binding.reference: P1_H3_incumbent_refit (both-EW logistic) fit with the EXECUTED comparison.py procedure (C=1.0 max_iter=1000, StandardScaler base_train only, block sigmoid cal) - on the SAME full base_train as the LightGBM refit
baseline_binding.contrast_definition: contrast = P2_lgbm_equal_info_v2 - P1_H3_incumbent_refit on identical pooled rows under the same shared draw stream
baseline_binding.per_contrast_interval_reporting: EVERY registered contrast carries its own explicit unadjusted 95% percentile interval plus its own null-centered p-value; no contrast may be registered without interval reporting

registered_contrasts.interval_reporting: EXPLICIT: ci95_unadjusted percentile interval + null_centered p_value + p_holm emitted per contrast

baseline_binding.interval_coverage_verification: verified at freeze time: every entry in registered_contrasts has explicit interval reporting (the registered set is exactly {C_lgbm_v2_vs_both_EW_logistic}); Holm applies across the registered family (one contrast: p_holm == p_value); adding a contrast later requires adding its interval reporting in the same registration

folds.confirm_and_2026_exclusion: confirm_2025H2 excluded - not scored; 2026 rows remain CLOSED (no 2026 loads, no 2026 tuning)
